name: test-unmanaged-2
reason: Unmanaged rule created directly in SCM to exercise the detect-delete-evidence flow. No request authorised it; ADR-0011 deletes unmanaged drift rather than adopting it. Open violation recorded at evidence/violations/GitOps-security-rule-test-unmanaged-2.json, first seen run 31930662415.
record_written_by: RECONSTRUCTED FROM THE RUN LOG on 2026-08-16. The DELETE succeeded and the record step then crashed on NameError: _json, so the workflow wrote nothing and its pull-request step was skipped. An irreversible action left no evidence — the exact failure this workflow exists to prevent. object_id and tags come from the log line 'deleting security-rule ... (id=...) tags=none'; 'at' is the timestamp of the 'OK — deleted' line. Fixed in the same commit.
